def bb(f,ch):
    G=[list(r) for r in f.ascii.split('\n')]
    s={(r,c) for r in range(len(G)) for c in range(len(G[0])) if G[r][c]==ch}
    if not s: return None
    rs=[r for r,c in s]; cs=[c for r,c in s]; return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),len(s))

print('UP -> board_changed',res.get('board_changed'))
print('AFTER:  W',bb(current_frame,'W'),'Y',bb(current_frame,'Y'),'G',bb(current_frame,'G'))

def bb(f,ch):
    G=[list(r) for r in f.ascii.split('\n')]
    s={(r,c) for r in range(len(G)) for c in range(len(G[0])) if G[r][c]==ch}
    if not s: return None
    rs=[r for r,c in s]; cs=[c for r,c in s]; return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),len(s))
